Grateful to hear directly from the men and women who sacrificed so much for our country. Their perspective will help shape how we support veterans in Florida.

We can never fully repay the debt we owe our veterans, but as Governor, I will do everything I can to serve them well.

It was an honor to give the keynote speech at the Florida Farm Bureau Federation’s meeting this morning in Gainesville. Their endorsement means a lot to me.
 
Florida’s agricultural community is more than important — it’s the backbone of our state. Our farmers work hard day in and day out to help feed America and make us proud.
 
As Governor, I will work tirelessly to fight for our farmers.
